B_acceptedByNormalizer.title: Returning any disables type checking for every response assertion in this suite. Use typed helpers for list and error responses (or return unknown and validate it) so mistakes in the asserted payload shape are caught.

The rejection tests never exercise offset or the upper limit bound, so removing those validations would leave the suite passing despite breaking the 400 contract. Add cases for invalid offsets (for example, a negative or non-integer value) and a limit above 100, asserting both status and field.

Explicitly empty pagination values such as limit= and offset= are silently treated as omitted, despite the stated contract that unusable values return 400. The status check below also accepts status=. Default only absent parameters and reject explicitly empty values with the corresponding field.
